findings.evidence: Lines 171–172 state that `(rfl)` is chosen to keep the proofs out of the exported definitional-equality check; the three theorem bodies are `:= (rfl)` at lines 176, 181, and 245.
findings.fix: Prove these lemmas by explicitly unfolding the relevant definition and applying `dihedralFun_r`/`dihedralFun_sr`, or add a private implementation lemma and derive all three public theorems from it without raw definitional equality.
findings.issue: `dihedralHom_r`, `dihedralHom_sr`, and `dihedralGroupMulEquiv_apply` (lines 175, 180, 242) use parenthesized `rfl` specifically to evade the exported definitional-equality check, so public behavior depends on reducibility through implementation wrappers.

summary: Three exported API lemmas deliberately rely on wrapper definitional equality, making them fragile under implementation refactoring.
